svg.title: Nepal: construction sheet
svg.text: A star’s or sun’s size is the circle through its points, shown dashed.
The white disc has a disc cut out of it, drawn dashed.
The white star keeps only what’s inside its clip, a rect, drawn dashed.
The outline is the polygon through the 5 corners the file lists, each at places marked along the edges.
Sizes in grid units, as the file gives them. Each charge’s center is marked +.
